summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing that it will sponsor a Learning Theater presentation at CHEST 2026, the annual meeting of the American College of Chest Physicians, on October 15, 2026. The presentation, hosted by Chief Medical Officer Gordon Downie, MD, will address the evolving role of CyPath Lung in lung cancer risk stratification and pulmonary nodule management, and will include preliminary research data from an investigational asthma and COPD test. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are present; this is an ordinary product and conference-update filing.
